World Bank WDI, all 6 countries, 2003-2023: 18/18 series fetched, 0 errors. UA unemp_wdi missing 2022-2023 (see gaps.csv).
robots.txt: Disallow: / for User-agent: * (only named search bots allowed); logged as a gap, not scraped

kworb.net robots.txt allows crawling, but the site offers no historical daily/weekly archive by date -- only a live today page and a lifetime-totals page; logged as a gap pending a decision on charts.spotify.com instead

UMich consumer sentiment via FRED (UMCSENT series), monthly, 2003-01 to 2023-12, 252 rows. Used FRED copy rather than umich.edu directly -- UMich own usage terms restrict redistribution without written consent; FRED republishes freely.

Egypt Nielsen quarterly CCI: 9 quarters transcribed (2010 Q1/Q3/Q4, 2011 Q1, 2012 Q4, 2014 Q3/Q4, 2015 Q1, 2016 Q2) via Daily News Egypt / Amwal Al Ghad republication, since ahram.org.eg (the primary IDSC/Nielsen English outlet) returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches. One ambiguous Q3 2013 figure (94) excluded: the same article states both a 6-point and a 2-point YoY change, which don't reconcile and may refer to different (Egypt vs regional) indices -- flagged, not written.

Egypt IDSC monthly CCI: 3 months transcribed (2012-11, 2014-02, 2014-03) via Egypt Independent / Daily News Egypt. ahram.org.eg blocks automated fetches (HTTP 403) for every one of the ~15 IDSC article URLs in the data-acquisition brief, so most of 2011-2014 remains inaccessible despite being reported in search snippets (not independently verifiable, so not transcribed).

Ukraine Info Sapiens/GfK monthly CCI: 87 months transcribed (2018-02, 2018-03, 2018-05 individually verified from press-release PDFs; 2019-01 through 2025-12, 84 months, from the sapiens.com.ua other-research archive index, cross-checked against 5 individually-opened PDF press releases with matching values). 2009-2017 not found in an accessible source (sapiens.com.ua's own archive listing starts Jan 2019).

Thailand UTCC monthly CCI: 12 months transcribed across 2003, 2019, 2021, 2023 and 2026 from utcc.ac.th's own press pages, Trading Economics summary stats (record high/low), and news republication (nationthailand.com, opendevelopmentmekong.net). No public historical table/download found on utcc.ac.th or thaichamber.co.th; Trading Economics and CEIC gate the full monthly series behind paid plans.

Hong Kong CUHK quarterly Index of Consumer Sentiment: 4 quarters transcribed (2010Q3=97.2, 2013Q3=82.0, 2015Q3=83.6, 2016Q3=82.5). Source PDFs live on a web archive (webarchive.lib.cuhk.edu.hk) that returns a bot-check/verification page to automated fetches; values came from search-engine-indexed snippets of those PDFs, not a directly re-opened document -- project owner should spot-check before relying on these 4 points.

Hong Kong CityU quarterly CCI (Hong Kong sub-index): 2 quarters transcribed (2019Q3=52.8, 2020Q2=66.2). cityu.edu.hk press-release pages are JS-rendered and returned empty body text to every direct fetch attempt; these 2 values came from search-engine-indexed quotes of the release text instead.

Uruguay UCU/Equipos Consultores ICC: 10 bimonthly readings transcribed, 2023-06 through 2026-06, from equipos.com.uy press-release pages (and one PDF). 2007-08 through 2023-05 not transcribed: PDF releases for that period either 404'd or decoded as unrelated content, and news-article coverage of 2011/2019/2021/2022 values was found only as search snippets (not independently opened) before the session's WebFetch quota was exhausted mid-task.

Follow-up pass after WebFetch quota reset. HK cci_cuhk improved from 4 to 9 quarters (added 2014-06, 2014-09, 2014-12, 2017-09, 2018-01) via further search-engine snippets of the same bot-blocked CUHK web-archive PDFs; also tried a different CUHK PDF mirror (cpr.cuhk.edu.hk) which turned out to host the Quality-of-Life annual index (a different series), not consumer sentiment, and was itself unreadable (compressed PDF stream). HK cci_cityu improved from 2 to 3 quarters (added 2021-Q4=70.6); cityu.edu.hk, www6.cityu.edu.hk and the zh-cn path all still return empty body text to direct fetches post-reset, confirming this is a persistent JS-rendering issue, not a transient rate limit -- a Q3 2023 figure was found but excluded due to a conflict between two secondary sources (86.8 vs 87.6). UY cci_ucu improved from 10 to 11 points (added 2022-03=45.8, directly fetched from montevideo.com.uy); a 2012 PDF (Confianza_del_consumidor_Ene-12.pdf) was located but the article citing it gave only a percent change, not an absolute value. TH cci_utcc improved from 12 to 13 months (added 2013-01=72.1 from pattayamail.com). EG cci_idsc_eg: no new points found; remaining 2011 ahram.org.eg articles give only percentage changes with no absolute index value in any accessible non-ahram source.
